thread:
Alice Park: Quick sync — proposing telemetry-first prioritization for the Optimize toolkit. We should rank batching / caching / quantization recs + eval-triggered alerts by real customer impact, not gut. Key ask: define scoring formula, launch gating metrics, and owners. Thoughts?

Mateo Gomez: Love that. Main signals: high-latency sessions, per-customer inference spend, and eval regression rate. Can we get a nightly rank table?

Priya Shah: Agree. Proposal for impact score = (sessions_with_latency>300ms * avg_tokens) * (1 - quant_compatibility_penalty).

Raj Patel: Can we add a safety filter: customers on private infra or custom models -> lower priority unless they opt-in. Also need rollout SLOs.

Jen Liu: For launch gating I'd want: 1) Pilot customers show >=10% cost reduction OR >=20% p95 latency improvement, 2) No increase in eval-alert regressions (>2% new regressions is fail), 3) Tooltips + SDK docs ready.

Mateo Gomez: I'll wire up a quick SQL to estimate. Query below — run on telemetry-prod: 
```
SELECT customer_id,
  COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  SUM(case when latency_ms>300 then 1 else 0 end) AS high_latency_sessions,
  AVG(tokens) as avg_tokens
FROM inference_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY high_latency_sessions DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Alice Park: Nice. Priya + Raj please own the scoring and safety filter. Mateo can run the table and add a new dashboard. Jen will draft acceptance checklist. ops-bot: create a ticket template for pilot signups.

ops-bot: Ticket created: OPT-PRIO-4310 — Pilot onboarding template (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPT-PRIO-4310)

Priya Shah: For eval-triggered alerts, we should specify types: latency regressions, token-quality regressions (BLEU/ROUGE drop for labeled tasks), and hallucination rate increase for closed-domain customers.

Raj Patel: Also add a "rollback budget": if pilot causes >1% of requests with bad responses (customer-labeled), auto-fallback after N minutes.

Jen Liu: Proposed rollout: internal alpha -> 3 pilot customers (diverse infra) -> 10% canary -> 50% -> full. Metric watchers: cost savings, p95, eval-alerts, customer support volume.

Mateo Gomez: ETA for dashboard + sample ranking table: EOD Friday. I'll post link.

Alice Park: Great. Next check-in Thu 11am PT. Owners: Mateo (data), Priya (scoring), Raj (safety/rollback), Jen (acceptance/doc), Alice (roadmap + comms). :thumbsup: 

Jen Liu: +1. I'll start an internal doc and tag legal for privacy review. :spiral_note_pad: 

Mateo Gomez: Dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/optimize-prio (placeholder)

Priya Shah: Quick question — do we weight cost savings more than latency? I vote cost*0.6 + latency*0.4.

Alice Park: Let's default cost 0.6, latency 0.4 but make weights configurable per-customer in dashboard.

Raj Patel: Logged action: create cutover playbook + rollback hooks. I'll add to ENG runbook.

Jen Liu: I'll draft the acceptance checklist in the doc and ping design for UI microcopy.

Alice Park: Thanks all. Thread closed pending dashboard and owners' updates.
